snippet.title: Witchpop // Trailer
snippet.description:
Steam ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3248200/Witchpop

Witchpop is a physics based matching puzzle game where you cook soup by juggling ingredients. Collect curses over time and try to survive as your dish becomes an increasingly chaotic mess.

Developed by
Havlark Games
